en.text: The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

zhSimplified.text: 大能者 神—耶和华已经发言招呼天下，

zhTraditional.text: 大能者上帝－耶和華已經發言招呼天下，

en.text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, shines out.

zhSimplified.text: 从全美的中，

zhTraditional.text: 從全美的中，

en.text: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

zhSimplified.text: 我们的 神要来，决不闭口。

zhTraditional.text: 我們的上帝要來，決不閉口。

en.text: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

zhSimplified.text: 他招呼上天下地，

zhTraditional.text: 他招呼上天下地，

en.text: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

zhSimplified.text: 说：招聚我的圣民到我这里来，

zhTraditional.text: 說：招聚我的聖民到我這裏來，

en.text: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

zhSimplified.text: 诸天必表明他的公义，

zhTraditional.text: 諸天必表明他的公義，

en.text: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

zhSimplified.text: 我的民哪，你们当听我的话！ 啊，我要劝戒你；

zhTraditional.text: 我的民哪，你們當聽我的話！ 啊，我要勸戒你；

en.text: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

zhSimplified.text: 我并不因你的祭物责备你；

zhTraditional.text: 我並不因你的祭物責備你；

en.text: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

zhSimplified.text: 我不从你家中取公牛，

zhTraditional.text: 我不從你家中取公牛，

en.text: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

zhSimplified.text: 因为，树林中的百兽是我的，

zhTraditional.text: 因為，樹林中的百獸是我的，

en.text: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

zhSimplified.text: 山中的飞鸟，我都知道；

zhTraditional.text: 山中的飛鳥，我都知道；

en.text: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

zhSimplified.text: 我若是饥饿，我不用告诉你，

zhTraditional.text: 我若是飢餓，我不用告訴你，

en.text: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

zhSimplified.text: 我岂吃公牛的肉呢？

zhTraditional.text: 我豈吃公牛的肉呢？

en.text: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

zhSimplified.text: 你们要以感谢为祭献与 神，

zhTraditional.text: 你們要以感謝為祭獻與上帝，

en.text: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

zhSimplified.text: 并要在患难之日求告我；

zhTraditional.text: 並要在患難之日求告我；

en.text: But to the wicked God says, What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

zhSimplified.text: 但 神对恶人说：你怎敢传说我的律例，

zhTraditional.text: 但上帝對惡人說：你怎敢傳說我的律例，

en.text: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

zhSimplified.text: 其实你恨恶管教，

zhTraditional.text: 其實你恨惡管教，

en.text: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

zhSimplified.text: 你见了盗贼就乐意与他同伙，

zhTraditional.text: 你見了盜賊就樂意與他同夥，

en.text: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

zhSimplified.text: 你口任说恶言；

zhTraditional.text: 你口任說惡言；

en.text: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

zhSimplified.text: 你坐着毁谤你的兄弟，

zhTraditional.text: 你坐着毀謗你的兄弟，

en.text: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

zhSimplified.text: 你行了这些事，我还闭口不言，

zhTraditional.text: 你行了這些事，我還閉口不言，

en.text: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

zhSimplified.text: 你们忘记 神的，要思想这事，

zhTraditional.text: 你們忘記上帝的，要思想這事，

en.text: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

zhSimplified.text: 凡以感谢献上为祭的便是荣耀我；

zhTraditional.text: 凡以感謝獻上為祭的便是榮耀我；
